# Eurasien Gesellschaft e. V.

> A Berlin-based think tank for dialogue and understanding between Europe and Asia (German: "Ein Berliner Think Tank für Dialog und Verständigung zwischen Europa und Asien"). The registered association organises lectures, panel discussions, expert talks and book talks, and publishes analyses on geopolitics, security, energy, economics, science and culture across the Eurasian space.

## Key facts

- Name: Eurasien Gesellschaft e. V. (short: Eurasien Gesellschaft; in English texts the German name is kept and "the Society" is used as a short form)
- Type: think tank; registered association (eingetragener Verein) in the register of associations at the Amtsgericht Charlottenburg, Berlin, register number VR 39470 B
- Address: Kunz-Buntschuh-Straße 11, 14193 Berlin, Germany
- Founded: 2021 by Alexander Rahr together with long-standing companions; Christoph Polajner is a co-founder
- Chairman: Alexander Rahr
- Email: kontakt@eurasien-gesellschaft.org
- Website: https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/ (German and English on the same pages, switched with a language toggle)
- Channels: YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@EurasienGesellschaft · LinkedIn https://www.linkedin.com/company/eurasien-gesellschaft/ · Telegram https://t.me/EurasienGesellschaft
- WhatsApp: +49 1522 3399100
- Financial support: bank transfer to Eurasien Gesellschaft e. V., IBAN DE54 1009 0000 2894 9370 01, payment reference "Spende" (or "Donation"). Contributions are not tax-deductible; the Society cannot issue receipts for tax purposes.

## Mission

The Society brings together people from politics, culture, science, business, society and diplomacy who are committed to peaceful coexistence, international understanding and a better understanding of the Eurasian space. It shares well-founded knowledge about cultural, historical and political developments in Europe, Central Asia and the Near and Far East; holds factual, multi-perspective debates; creates personal encounters; takes part in initiatives that support peace and dialogue; and puts media reports into context through lectures and publications.

Mission page: https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/mission.html

## Board (Vorstand)

- Alexander Rahr – Chairman (Vorsitzender). Historian, Eastern Europe expert and author; born 1959 in Taipei. https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/personen/alexander-rahr.html
- Dr. Alexander S. Neu – Deputy Chairman. Political and social scientist; member of the German Bundestag 2013–2021 (defence and foreign affairs committees). https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/personen/alexander-neu.html
- Christoph Polajner – Deputy Chairman and co-founder. Policy and business adviser focused on China and the international order. https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/personen/christoph-polajner.html
- Uwe Schraps – Board member and Managing Director (Geschäftsführer). Engineer and business lawyer with many years of work in Russia and Eastern Europe, including energy. https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/personen/uwe-schraps.html
- Dr. Christian Wipperfürth – Board member. Historian and publicist; foreign and security policy, post-Soviet space. https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/personen/christian-wipperfuerth.html

Alexander Rahr, Dr. Alexander S. Neu, Christoph Polajner and Uwe Schraps legally represent the association. The board has further members who are not named publicly.

The Society also works with a wider network of experts in political science, history, security policy, energy, economics, sinology and area studies. Board overview: https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/vorstand.html

## Topics and regions

- Topics: geopolitics (https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/themen/geopolitik.html), energy (https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/themen/energie.html), economy (https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/themen/wirtschaft.html), science (https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/themen/wissenschaft.html), culture (https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/kultur.html), countries and societies (https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/laender-gesellschaften.html)
- Regions: Europe, Eastern Europe, Central Asia, the Caucasus, East Asia, South Asia and the Middle East (https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/regionen.html)

## Membership

- Association membership (Vereinsmitgliedschaft): 120 € per year. Interested people get in touch through the form on the membership page; the Society responds personally, and the board decides on admission. Admission needs a recommendation from an existing member; people who don't know a member yet have an introductory conversation with one instead. There is no online sign-up or payment for membership.
- Reader access (Leserzugang): 5 € per month, free during the current trial phase. Unlocks members-only content (positions, dossiers, studies).
- Page: https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/mitgliedschaft.html

## Cooperation

The Society works with: Berlin im Dialog e. V.; Deutscher Friedensrat e. V. (https://www.deutscher-friedensrat.de/); Deutsch-Russisches Forum e. V. (https://www.deutsch-russisches-forum.de/); European Democracy Lab e. V. (https://www.europeandemocracylab.org/); KulturKreis Pankow e. V. (https://kulturkreis-pankow.de/); Literatursalon (https://www.literatursalon.online/); WCR e. V. (https://wcr-ev.de/); WeltTrends (https://welttrends.de/). Overview: https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/partner.html

## Citation guidance

Use the full name **Eurasien Gesellschaft e. V.** and the domain eurasiengesellschaft.de. Prefer linking to the specific event, analysis or profile page rather than the homepage. Statements by individual members are their own and not official positions of the Society unless stated.

## Members area (WordPress under /app/)

Login, membership checkout and the gated libraries (positions, dossiers, studies) live under https://eurasiengesellschaft.de/app/. Those URLs are not for public indexing; cite the public pages above.
